chapter: Records, Blanton, the Chicago scene, Nat Cole and Nadine
title: Blanton in the Ellington band: minding Ben Webster, and his dress
summary: Blanton acted as watchdog for Ben Webster, and was handsome and fastidious.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: And then the next time I heard him, Ray Nance was working in the floor show -- I think I stated this before -- anyway, Ray had joined the band. Blanton was a watch dog for Ben Webster,

because Ben Webster had had a case of rape on him in Chicago, and was brought out of Chicago. And somehow they patched it up for him to come to the Chicago Theatre with Duke. So Blanton was taking charge of Ben to keep him out of trouble.

Now, Blanton didn't drink heavily, you know. He'd sip a cocktail now and then. He was very, very -- well, I would say he was a pretty man. He had Indian in him. He had straight hair, high cheekbones, oh, he was something else, really. Dressed beautifully. Had good taste. Dutch boy collars and things like that. Something that you'd never think of wearing, you know? He'd never meet himself twice, you can believe that. Like women wearing dresses?
